cases.reason: Washington placed Terry McLaurin on injured reserve with a season-ending patellar-tendon tear. Official team reporting says Antonio Williams will receive more targets and Treylon Burks and Dyami Brown are better suited to McLaurin's vacated spot, while Stefon Diggs' workload should not increase. The three included candidates each carry the identical locked 0.2 Walters value, making the replacement value invariant to unknown shares. Repository M4 production alone owns exact arithmetic, unified personnel-overlay recomputation and board rounding.
